{{Quote|I was a general in the Imperial military service. Did they tell you that when they sent you here? Did they even know?|The General, to his assassins on the ''Brentaal Star''|<ref name="Black Talon" />}}
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] codenamed "'''The General'''" was an officer [[General/Legends|holding that rank]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military forces]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the General defected to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in an effort to stop both sides from [[Galactic War|restarting the war]], learning that Republic and Empire alike were constructing doomsday weapons, and bringing the Empire's secrets to the Republic to prevent more bloodshed. The General was en route to Republic space onboard the warship ''[[Brentaal Star]]'', under the protection of the [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], [[Satele Shan]].

The General's defection did not sit well with the Empire. [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Rycus Kilran]], deputy to the [[Minister of War (Sith Empire)|Minister of War]], ordered Captain [[Revinal Orzik]] of the transport ship ''[[Black Talon]]'' to intercept the ''Brentaal Star'' and capture or kill the General. Seeing no sense in sending a transport to fight a warship, Orzik refused, and so Kilran tapped a small strike team departing [[Vaiken Spacedock]] for [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] onboard the ''Black Talon'' to carry out his orders. Setting the ''Black Talon'' on course to intercept, the strike team landed on the ''Brentaal Star'' and hunted the General through the decks, until finally catching up to him and his Jedi protector, [[Yadira Ban]], near the ship's escape pods.

{{GameDS}}
After killing Yadira, the strike team confronted the General, who was less than surprised that Kilran was behind the attack. Seriously wounded, the General made no effort to fight or flee, instead stating his reasons for his defection. The strike team chose to execute the General, who grimly accepted his fate. Kilran later expressed disappointment that the General wasn't taken alive.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Players are given two options to determine the General's fate. The first is to take him into custody, for interrogation and later execution (surprisingly, the light side choice), or to simply kill him on the spot (the dark side choice). Should players choose to take him alive, Kilran is pleased and says he will let the Sith and Imperial Intelligence fight over him.
